twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
twoFactor.description: Enhance account security using TOTP time-based one-time passwords, with flexible authentication policies
twoFactor.sudoModeDesc: Normal password login; secondary TOTP verification only required for high-risk sensitive operations
twoFactor.loginModeDesc: Require a 6-digit TOTP code or backup code on every login, providing maximum account protection
twoFactor.step1Title: Step 1: Scan QR code with your authenticator app
twoFactor.step1Desc: Scan the QR code below using Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or 1Password:
twoFactor.step3Desc: If you lose access to your authenticator app, you can use these recovery codes to sign in (each code can only be used once):
twoFactor.step4Desc: Enter the 6-digit verification code currently shown in your authenticator app:
twoFactor.setupSuccess: Two-factor authentication has been enabled successfully!
twoFactor.disableModalDesc: Disabling 2FA reduces account security. Enter your account password and a 6-digit TOTP code to confirm:
twoFactor.switchPolicyModalDesc: Enter the 6-digit verification code from your authenticator app to confirm switching policy:
twoFactor.policyHint: Click a card to switch authentication policy (requires one-time code confirmation)
twoFactor.feature1Desc: Fully compatible with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden, and standard TOTP apps.
twoFactor.feature2Desc: Choose between low-friction Sudo Mode (sensitive action verification only) and Login Protection Mode (required on every sign-in).
twoFactor.feature3Desc: Generates 8 single-use encrypted recovery codes so you can regain account access if you ever lose your phone or security key.
twoFactor.securityTip: Security recommendation: Administrator accounts possess elevated privileges. Enabling 2FA is strongly recommended to eliminate credential stuffing and takeover risks.
twoFactor.recoveryCodesReadyDesc: If you lose your device or cannot access your authenticator app, you can use one of your single-use recovery codes to sign in.
twoFactor.scanQrSubtitle: Scan the QR code below with your authenticator app
twoFactor.expandManualSecret: Can't scan? Click to view secret
twoFactor.backupCodesWarning: Please store these backup codes safely. If your authenticator device is lost or damaged, backup codes are the only way to recover account access.
twoFactor.verifyActivationTitle: Enter the 6-digit verification code to activate
twoFactor.verifyActivationSubtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for SOC Copilot:
twoFactor.verifyDynamicTip: 💡 Codes refresh every 30 seconds. Paste is supported.
twoFactor.confirmSwitchOtpDesc: Enter 6-digit code to confirm policy switch
